actualAuthorReading: All27 complete query objects,29 entries,96 senses and52 Japanese forms actually read before freeze, including all restrictions/notes/attributions;16 Wikipedia pseudo-definitions not lexical evidence.
adjudication: 服 explicitly includes ordinary, especially Western clothing; 洋服 is Western-style clothing, not country of manufacture or only formal suits. Generic clothing does not automatically make every garment a synonym.
シャツ includes outer shirts and undershirts; ワイシャツ is a dress/business shirt, not necessarily white today. Preserve Ｙシャツ and Ｔシャツ forms.
Both source コート senses adopted: coat and sports court. Separate coating sense not adopted.

上着 includes coat/jacket/outerwear and an upper-body garment, not only heavy winter clothing. 履く and 着る retain item/body-area restrictions, without a universal Russian-aspect equivalence for resulting-state ～ている.
ズボン retains French jupon source note without confusing the modern Japanese word with the modern French garment. パンツ ambiguity is preserved.
眼鏡 retains eyewear sense, alternate めがね spelling and additional がんきょう reading; derogatory, judgement, place-name and Wikipedia senses are not adopted.

時計 uses frozen jukujikun technical classification for irregular whole-word reading; it does not license a freely reusable と reading of 時. The physical-device gloss must remain distinct from baseline 時間 duration/unit.
履く preserves sourceN5 despite API3; 眼鏡 preserves sourceN5 despite API1/5; 掛ける preserves sourceN5 despite API4/5. Clothing spelling 履く/穿く contrast retained, not unrelated sword/archaic senses.
掛ける adopts the frozen hanging and phone-call scopes, not all25 captured senses; 眼鏡 contextually teaches its attested glasses collocation. Auxiliary 掛かる hanging and exact 壁に掛ける phrase verified.
ネクタイ legitimately has three source H2 sections: a redundant kanji-combination section is not invented for a kana-only loanword.

背広 attribution checked in the actual Nipponica article, not the first World Encyclopedia block returned by simplified Kotobank extraction. Competing etymologies remain qualified, not invented certainty.
Public API does not expose all per-spelling labels. Actual full Jisho HTML note spans, separately read below, corroborate inherited ateji claims for 時計 and 背広.
